articles.summary: What will it take to build a more diversified global solar supply chain? China’s manufacturing capacity is now twice global demand, reshaping global markets and making supply chain diversification an energy security priority. India has an opportunity to emerge as a competitive second source. Realising it will require manufacturing scale, cost competitiveness, access to capital and policies that reward supply chain resilience. Importing countries also have a role to play. Diversification requires recognising the strategic value of alternative sources, not just evaluating procurement on price. At ReNew, we operate 6.5 GW of module and 2.5 GW of cell capacity, with ingots and wafers next. The next phase of the solar transition must be about diversifying not just energy sources, but also where the technology is manufactured. From my conversation on The New Industrialists.
